title: Budget Boundary Effects in Test-Time Mathematical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.38699v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A cumulative token cap can fall inside a mathematical derivation, forcing a test-time controller to choose between stopping at the cap (strict) and allowing the current attempt to finish (advisory). We measure this boundary choice with paired offline replays of 19,200 public traces: 120 AIME, BrUMO and HMMT problems and two archive configurations of one model. Candidate order and a 16-attempt cap are fixed, and answer selection is blind to reference answers and correctness labels. Three findings emerge. First, at the 4k cap, most advisory accuracy gains replace abstention with a correct answer; strict stopping pays for an unfinished prefix that the completed-only selector cannot use. Second, comparisons along realized cost differ from same-cap comparisons: advisory 4k in low has higher accuracy than strict 8k at comparable mean completion cost, while in high its observed accuracy is 0.42 points below strict 32k using 59% of its mean toke

translated_title: 测试时数学推理中的预算边界效应
translated_abstract: 累计token上限可能落在一次数学推导的中间，迫使测试时控制器在“到达上限即停止”（严格式，strict）与“允许当前尝试完成”（建议式，advisory）之间做出选择。我们通过对19,200条公开轨迹的成对离线回放来测量这一边界选择：涉及120道AIME、BrUMO和HMMT题目以及同一模型的两种存档配置。候选顺序和16次尝试上限保持固定，答案选择对参考答案和正确性标签完全盲视。研究得出三个发现。第一，在4k上限下，建议式策略的准确率提升大多是将“弃权”替换为正确答案；严格式停止则为一个未完成前缀付出了代价，而仅基于已完成答案的选择器无法利用该前缀。第二，沿实际成本的比较与同上限比较存在差异：在低配置中，建议式4k在与严格式8k相当的平均完成成本下拥有更高准确率；而在高配置中，其观测准确率仅比严格式32k低0.42个百分点，却只使用了后者平均token量的59%……
tldr: 该论文通过19,200条轨迹的成对离线回放发现，当测试时数学推理的token预算上限落在推导中间时，建议式停止策略在可比成本下优于严格式停止策略，因为严格式停止会产生选择器无法利用的未完成前缀，造成预算浪费。
en_tdlr: By paired offline replays of 19,200 traces, this paper shows that when a test-time token budget cap falls mid-derivation, advisory stopping outperforms strict stopping at comparable cost, since strict stopping wastes unfinished prefixes that completed-only selectors cannot use.
